actual.descripcion: Omega European Masters, Second Round | The 2026 Omega European Masters Individual Stroke Play Round 2 continues at Crans-sur-Sierre Golf Club. Only the top 65 professional players (plus ties) in the 156-man field will advance to play the weekend rounds and secure a share of the purse.
